title: SugarCrushWeb — SugarCraft
description: SugarCrushWeb: browser UI for sugar-crush's WebSocket server mode. A Vite + Vue 3 bundle committed as dist/ and located by a one-class PHP shim, so sugarcrush serve needs no Node.
ogDescription: The browser face of sugar-crush's server mode — Vite + Vue 3 + TypeScript + Pinia, shipped pre-built through Composer.
tagline: Browser UI for sugar-crush's server mode
